O teste usa domínios de navegação, strea: The test uses browsing, streaming and gaming domains.
Índice = média entre as duas fases; falh: Score = average across both phases; failures receive a timeout penalty. Click a server to see details.
DNS mais rápido é só uma parte da experi: Faster DNS is only part of the experience.
O teste mede resolução de nomes. Não med: The test measures name resolution. It does not measure download speed, in-game ping or full page load time.
Compare os serviços que você usaria, com: Compare the services you would use, with the domain names you use every day.
Um por linha. Inclua domínios de serviço: One per line. Include service and third-party content domains.
HAR: só os hostnames das requisições são: HAR: only request hostnames are read, locally. Full URLs, cookies and content are not sent to the benchmark engine.
Consultar AAAA não exige conexão IPv6. O: AAAA queries do not require IPv6 connectivity. Transport to an IPv6 server requires a working IPv6 route.
Uma medição útil precisa mostrar também: A useful measurement must also explain its limitations.
Os mesmos nomes para todos: The same names for every resolver
Todos os servidores recebem o mesmo conj: All servers receive the same A/AAAA query set. Server and query order is shuffled in blocks, with the random seed recorded in the JSON. Testing one server at a time reduces competition caused by the benchmark itself.
O padrão usa 30 domínios como ponto de p: The default list uses 30 domains as a starting point, not a universal sample of the web. Import a HAR from your browser to make the test more representative of your usage.
A primeira passagem mede os nomes ainda: The first pass measures names not yet queried by this test. The provider may already have them cached. Later passes measure repeated queries, with no guarantee that entries remain cached.
O programa consulta diretamente cada IP: The application queries each selected IP directly. If it is a local intermediary such as 127.0.0.53, the test includes that service and any cache it maintains. A public resolver's cache cannot be flushed by this app. Services from the same provider may also share a cache. We do not generate random subdomains and present them as uncached positive lookups.
Índice = 50% da média de custo da primei: Score = 50% of the first-pass mean cost + 50% of the repeat-pass mean cost.
Cada falha custa no mínimo o timeout esc: Each failure costs at least the selected timeout. Both phases retain equal weight even when there are more repeats.
Mediana e P95 usam respostas válidas; fa: Median and P95 use valid responses; failures are reported separately. NXDOMAIN, SERVFAIL, refusals and blocking addresses do not gain an advantage by responding quickly. NOERROR without the requested record type (NODATA) is valid, but does not prove connectivity.
DNS clássico usa UDP e recorre a TCP se: Classic DNS uses UDP and falls back to TCP if the response is truncated. DoH negotiates HTTP/2, with HTTP/1.1 fallback recorded in the report. DoT uses TLS with certificate validation.
Conexões criptografadas são reaproveitad: Encrypted connections are reused per concurrency lane. Initial probes include connection setup and are shown separately from the ranking. Reconnections during the test still count. DoH also connects to the selected IP while preserving SNI and TLS validation.
Repita em horários diferentes e com a re: Repeat at different times while avoiding heavy downloads on your network. Small differences, limited samples and route changes do not support a definitive conclusion. We do not calculate statistical significance.
O DNS pode influenciar o direcionamento: DNS can influence CDN routing, but this test does not measure throughput, video quality, gaming latency or page load time. Providers with blocking policies serve different purposes.
O JSON contém configuração, semente, IPs: The JSON includes configuration, random seed, IPs, queries, responses, TTL, failures and batch times. The CSV contains one row per query. The resolver's AD bit is recorded; we do not perform independent DNSSEC validation.
Servidores sem resposta na sondagem fica: Servers that do not respond to initial probes remain visible as unavailable and are not ranked. Interrupted results are partial. Queries are sent to the selected resolvers; there is no telemetry.
